name: App API (capability runtime + encrypted token store)
purpose: runs the app-api capability pipeline locally on PowOS: the encrypted token store, the runtime call path (safety enforcement + handle-injected auth + audit), the `powos app` CLI, the AI tools and widget bindings, and appcap_serve.py: the App API app's loopback service on 127.0.0.1:3411 (a system-tier service, lib/apps/services/app-api.json; the port locked to the PowOS uid by powos-start.sh). Offline/LAN-only; no Mac or cloud at runtime. Design: docs/APP-API-CAPTURE.md.
installedBy: targets/android/rooted/powos-deploy.sh (tools/app-api, staged by rooted.sh deploy); also installable on desktop PowOS

remove.note: the state dir holds the encrypted token store + audit log; removal keeps it by default so re-install is seamless. Delete ~/.local/state/powos/app-api manually to wipe stored sessions.

network_note: lan-only; no outbound except to apps the user has explicitly enabled
